insight: Aimed at production: clean topology and PBR materials, where most image-to-3D tools still output messy, unusable meshes.
name: Rodin
tagline: Deemos' image-to-3D for high-fidelity, production-ready meshes.
description: Deemos' Rodin (Hyper3D) turns images or text into high-fidelity 3D models with clean geometry and PBR materials, aimed at game and film asset pipelines.
